name: application-assignee-picker
title: Assignee Picker
description: Searchable member dropdowns with avatars and checkmarks for single or multi-person task assignment in project and issue tools.
useWhen: Searchable member dropdowns with avatars and checkmarks for single or multi-person task assignment in project and issue tools.
avoidWhen: Avoid assignee picker when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Assignee Picker uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
